title: Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2604.09443v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model agents receive instructions from many sources-system messages, user prompts, tool outputs, other agents, and more-each carrying different levels of trust and authority. When these instructions conflict, agents must reliably follow the highest-privilege instruction to remain safe and effective. The dominant paradigm, instruction hierarchy (IH), assumes a fixed, small set of privilege levels (typically fewer than five) defined by rigid role labels (e.g., system > user). This is inadequate for real-world agentic settings, where conflicts can arise across far more sources and contexts. In this work, we propose Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH), a paradigm for resolving instruction conflicts among instructions with arbitrarily many privilege levels. translated_title: 大语言模型智能体中的多层级指令层次结构
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体会接收来自许多来源的指令——系统消息、用户提示、工具输出、其他智能体等——每个来源携带不同的信任度和权限级别。当这些指令发生冲突时，智能体必须可靠地遵循最高权限的指令，以保持安全性和有效性。当前主流范式“指令层次结构”假设存在一个固定的小型权限级别集合（通常少于五个），由僵化的角色标签定义（例如，系统 > 用户）。这对于现实世界的智能体场景来说是不够的，因为在这些场景中，冲突可能在远多于此的来源和上下文之间产生。在这项工作中，我们提出了多层级指令层次结构，这是一种用于解决具有任意多权限级别的指令之间冲突的新范式。我们引入了ManyIH-Bench，这是首个针对ManyIH的基准测试。ManyIH-Bench要求模型在多达12层的具有不同优先级的冲突指令中进行导航与决策。
tldr: 该论文提出了多层级指令层次结构新范式及其首个基准测试ManyIH-Bench，用于解决大语言模型智能体在面对任意多权限级别指令冲突时如何遵循最高权限指令的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH), a new paradigm with the first benchmark ManyIH-Bench, enabling LLM agents to resolve instruction conflicts across arbitrarily many privilege levels rather than a fixed small set of privilege tiers.
